column3: With respect to the 651 Brannan Street Mortgage Loan (3.5%), Pinterest, the largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property, has a right of first negotiation, pursuant to which the borrower must give notice to Pinterest if the borrower intends to sell the building. Pinterest must notify the borrower within 10 days if it is interested in purchasing the Mortgaged Property, at which point Pinterest and the borrower will have an additional 10 business days to negotiate the terms of sale, during which time the borrower cannot enter into a letter of intent or accept another offer for the Mortgaged Property.
